header.productTitle: Double Scoop Ice Cream Tongue Scraper
header.superHtml:
SuperMouth tongue scrapers help keep the mouth in tip-top shape by helping to remove harmful bacteria that causes bad breath while making room for beneficial bacteria. Little superheroes get two scoops with this tongue scraper, and while superheroes usually don’t exude bad behavior, this time around, we encourage kids to stick their tongues out at bad breath and unhealthy mouths.

  • a super soft bristled brush that reaches into the fine crevices of the tongue
  • a scraper to scoop out food debris to reduce tooth decay
  • recommended for ages: 6-12 years

left.title: Whole-Mouth Satisfaction Guaranteed
left.text: We are so confident you'll love our customized oral care solutions, we offer a 30-day money-back guarantee. Experience the best in oral health—risk-free.

HOW TO USE
items.html: Stick your tongue out and brush all the surfaces Start at the back of your tongue & gently run the scraper all the way to the front two or three times Rinse the scraper under warm water between scrapes Swish your mouth out with water afterward
